action_options.name: Property promotion weekend
action_options.targets: One slot-tournament weekend, Jul 18-20 (first weekend after the 14-day lead)
action_options.evidence: gold_event_lift: the Winter Slot Tournament lifted coin-in 18% over same-weekday medians; Locals Appreciation Week only 4%. No sign the lift was borrowed: the 7 days before/after the tournament ran +0.9% / -0.1% vs. their medians. Two observations only.
action_options.assumption: Low/base/high = the lowest, mean and highest lift seen at the two property promotions, applied to a recent non-event Fri-Sun. Prizes and marketing are inside the catalogue price. Run one weekend first; the second unit is only bought if the first clears break-even.
action_options.measurement: Coin-in vs. the validated weekday forecast (gold_forecast) for the promo weekend and the two weekends either side.

action_options.name: Machine inspection and paytable verification
action_options.evidence: gold_machine_scorecard: M-1158 hits 38.6% of spins vs the 31.5% its published paytable allows, over 674k spins (z = +124), and held 3.0% vs 10% theo (luck z = -4.6, beyond the 3.6 cut-off for 310 machines). No other machine is off spec beyond chance.
action_options.assumption: Base: the paytable is off spec and is corrected the day after inspection, recovering the machine’s average daily shortfall vs theo for 29 days. Low: nothing is found (it was extreme luck). High: the shortfall was growing (Mar-May hold ran near 0%), +25%.
action_options.measurement: Paytable/RTP verification report per machine; then weekly hit rate vs spec (control chart, z within +/-3) and hold vs theo.

action_options.name: Replace a machine with a leased new title
action_options.evidence: gold_machine_scorecard: these earn about half the theo of same-zone peers with equal uptime (fair index ~0.5, 95% CI width < 0.02); Royal Draw’s 95% RTP does not buy extra play (demand index ~1.0). New leased Aurora Link titles run at 1.37x par with no cannibalisation of neighbours (gold_natural_experiments: +1.6%).
action_options.assumption: Base: the new title earns par for its zone (index 1.0). Low: it reaches only 0.75 of par. High: it matches the Aurora Link installs (~1.37). 16 operating days after the 14-day lead; 6 h install downtime ignored (<0.1%).
action_options.measurement: Weekly fair index of each replaced position vs. its zone (target >= 0.9 by week 3), against the remaining weak earners as a holdout group.

action_options.name: Wayfinding and signage refresh for a zone
action_options.evidence: gold_natural_experiments: when walkway W-ENT-B40 closed (Mar 3 - Apr 6) Back Forty coin-in fell 29% vs. the rest of the floor and its door counter fell by the same share; play there tracks foot traffic. Back Forty is the largest location drag in the scorecard.
action_options.assumption: Base: signage recovers a 5% lift in Back Forty play (about a sixth of the access effect measured during the closure). Low: no effect. High: 10%. 20 days after the 10-day lead.
action_options.measurement: Difference-in-differences: Back Forty coin-in per machine-day and door-counter entries vs. other zones, 4 weeks before vs. after install.

action_options.name: Comp policy pilot with control group
action_options.targets: Random half of card holders back at ~12.5 points per comp dollar; other half stays at 5.8
action_options.evidence: gold_comp_change_test: the May 1 cut (12.3 -> 5.7 points per comp dollar) raised comp cost ~$78/day and reinvestment 1.19% -> 1.31%; carded share of play moved +0.5 pt, inside normal month-to-month noise.
action_options.assumption: Financial value in July is small; the value is a causal answer on whether cheaper comps buy play.
action_options.measurement: Randomised: visits, carded theo and comp cost per player, treatment vs control, 4 weeks.

action_options.name: Preventive maintenance sweep for one manufacturer
action_options.evidence: gold_manufacturer_reliability: Ridgeline fails 4.0 times per 100 machine-days vs 1.1-1.7 for the others; 55% of lost theo and $118k of repair cost in six months.
action_options.assumption: Base: the sweep cuts Ridgeline faults 25% for the rest of July (no maintenance outcome history exists to calibrate this). High: down to Northwind’s fault rate. Value = lost theo + direct repair cost avoided. 23 days after the 7-day lead.
action_options.measurement: Ridgeline faults per 100 machine-days vs. Northwind and Halcyon, 4 weeks before vs. after.

action_options.name: Add one technician to a shift for 30 days
action_options.targets: Grave shift (22:00-06:00), the only shift with one technician
action_options.evidence: gold_repair_response / gold_wait_vs_staffing: grave-shift faults wait ~2.0 h for a tech vs ~0.1 h when two techs are on; but a grave downtime hour costs only ~$16 of theo.
action_options.assumption: Base: grave wait falls to the two-tech level. High: grave wait disappears. 23 days after the 7-day lead.
action_options.measurement: Ticket wait time (opened -> work started) by shift.

action_options.name: Replace a machine with a leased new title
action_options.evidence: gold_machine_scorecard: of the 10 lowest raw earners, 2 are already retired, 1 is a 49-day-old install, 1 is a payout leak, and every Back Forty machine carries a -$26.7k location drag that a new cabinet in the same slot would inherit.
action_options.assumption: Same scenario rules as the fair plan; retired machines cannot be replaced.
